experiment: R71 frozen crop context and scale comparison
design_status: Fixed before any R71 crop inference. Publish source and protocol before executing the four notebook cells.

implementation_contract.baseline: unchanged original/reflected two-view corner averaging at input 1280
implementation_contract.point_validity_before_mapping: finite unclipped crop coordinates in [0,width) x [0,height)
implementation_contract.merge: union baseline then left crop then right crop, whole-record postclip NMS at IoU strictly above 0.70
implementation_contract.merge_score_ties: earlier pool index, baseline first then left/right native output order
implementation_contract.control: R69 fresh CPU, exact per-image score identities and known-corner threshold outcomes

question: Does adding two full-height crop predictions recover currently missed partial fronts without worsening extra detections, duplicate outputs or known-corner accuracy?

arms.description: Fresh original and reflected full-frame inference at 1280, established two-view corner averaging
Same baseline plus two full-height crops at native pixel scale. Context and additional candidate exposure both change.
Same baseline plus the same crops enlarged by 5/3. This adds resizing relative to the 768 arm.

crop_design.selection_basis: Two 768-pixel-wide full-height windows overlap by 256 pixels. Multiples of 32 retain the nominal stride-32 grid phase in the unscaled arm. Cropping still changes feature boundaries, available context and the candidate pool. Full height avoids artificial horizontal cuts.
crop_design.artificial_edges: Reject left-crop boxes with clipped xmax>=767 and right-crop boxes with clipped xmin<=1, measured after inverse letterbox in original crop pixels. Real photograph edges are allowed.
crop_design.keypoints: Record retained native points before clipping. Nonfinite coordinates or coordinates outside the half-open crop extent become unavailable with original confidence preserved. Valid coordinates are translated to the photograph. No crop point is inferred from an annotation.
crop_design.inverse_transform: Record actual input tensor, resized image size, per-axis gain and integer padding. Verify reconstructed clipped points against the pinned native implementation before using unclipped values.
crop_design.information_scope: Crops and interpolation reuse the existing photograph and supply no new camera observation.

containment_audit_after_window_selection.interpretation: Geometric feasibility only. This does not establish predicted-box retention or recovery.

crop_design.scale_interpretation: The 768 versus 1280 comparison includes interpolation, input tensor and candidate counts, and padding. A change does not by itself prove that small-object scale caused a baseline miss.
crop_design.point_policy_difference: Crop points use pre-clipping validity at every edge, including genuine photograph edges. The baseline retains its existing native clipping. Preserve invalidation lineage and inspect any affected corner outcomes.

merge_design.whole_records: Scores, boxes and both points stay together. Do not average a crop point into the existing two-view pair.
merge_design.suppression: Score-ranked class-aware established postclip NMS at IoU strictly above 0.70. Keep earlier pool index for a score tie. No additional global output cap.
merge_design.baseline_only_check: Require unchanged baseline records and matching outcomes when the same merge procedure receives only the baseline.
merge_design.risk_to_measure: A crop prediction may suppress a previously useful baseline prediction or replace accurate averaged corners with less accurate ones.

baseline_gate.required: All four references must reproduce R69 fresh-CPU per-image matching identities, extra/duplicate identities and known-corner five/ten-pixel outcomes. Record numerical coordinate/score differences as well.
baseline_gate.on_failure: Stop before crop inference and investigate the baseline discrepancy. Do not change treatment thresholds.

evaluation.primary_reference: r67, 658 fronts with 75 incomplete and 583 complete pairs
evaluation.other_references: r50, supplied664 and frozen666 are sensitivity checks on annotation versions of the same photographs.
required_outputs: recovered and newly lost target identities
source lineage for every pooled and retained record
inference call counts and tensor sizes
evaluation.selection_rule: Consider the added inference only if useful recovery is accompanied by preserved complete-pair outcomes, acceptable extra/duplicate outputs and no new empty-scene outputs. Report all tradeoffs. There is no automatic deployment or choice of thresholds from these results.
evaluation.data_scope: The 20 photographs are existing development evidence. This comparison is not independent-capture generalization evidence.

evidence_scope: Archive all retained native crop outputs and their mapping/filter/merge trace. This study does not inventory every low-confidence raw decoded candidate.
runtime_scope: Pinned CPU FP32 inference with 2 threads, 1 interop thread and deterministic algorithms. Timing is descriptive local-runtime evidence, not a deployment benchmark.

training_size_audit.interpretation: Nominal size counts describe this label set. They do not prove appearance coverage or the effective augmented training distribution.

research_basis.title: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference and Fine-tuning for Small Object Detection
research_basis.application: Overlapping inference crops and mapping predictions back. Use a native pose wrapper to preserve keypoints.

research_basis.title: AutoFocus: Efficient Multi-Scale Inference
research_basis.application: Avoid detections caused by artificial crop cuts. The fixed windows do not reproduce learned FocusPixels or adaptive chip generation.

research_basis.title: SNIPER: Efficient Multi-Scale Training
research_basis.application: Motivates accounting for difficult background if crop training is later warranted. No SNIPER training is performed here.
